statement: FA-I1 experimental inference program for the km.2 knowledge model (shadow, evaluation only; not a resource of the engine). Need-first and category-first conclusions with necessity/sufficiency, separate epistemic labels, owner contraindication rule; forbidden inferences F1-F12 are what these rules must never conclude.

vocabulary.name: et
vocabulary.meaning: entity E has type T

vocabulary.name: skind
vocabulary.meaning: strategy S has kind K

vocabulary.name: asr
vocabulary.meaning: assertion I: S P O, asserted A (affirmed|denied), modality M, effect E (none when absent)

vocabulary.name: req
vocabulary.meaning: strategy T requires capability F in requirement group G (affirmed requires_capability)

vocabulary.name: reqlevel
vocabulary.meaning: the requirement of F by T carries a level threshold on property P

vocabulary.name: levelmet
vocabulary.meaning: an observation about K meets the level of requirement (T,F) in the same unit under conditions comparable to the request (computed numerically by the script)

vocabulary.name: force
vocabulary.meaning: contraindication I has force F

vocabulary.name: hyp
vocabulary.meaning: assertion I is a hypothesis, or labelled proposed_not_tested, synthetic or hypothesis by its source, or refuted

vocabulary.name: cond
vocabulary.meaning: assertion I has a condition of kind K on R with force F and stance S

vocabulary.name: ctx
vocabulary.meaning: in the request, context R is in state S (holds|does_not_hold|unknown)

vocabulary.name: qtarget
vocabulary.meaning: the request states situation or need X

vocabulary.name: qartefact
vocabulary.meaning: the request names or asks about artefact K

vocabulary.name: excluded
vocabulary.meaning: the request negates or rejects E

vocabulary.name: confirms
vocabulary.meaning: a user fact confirms cause C

vocabulary.name: needdir
vocabulary.meaning: need N is direction R on dimension D

vocabulary.name: obs
vocabulary.meaning: observation O about artefact K of property P with statistic S

vocabulary.name: obsmeasured
vocabulary.meaning: observation O is a measured result

vocabulary.name: obscond
vocabulary.meaning: observation O was obtained under measurement condition R

vocabulary.name: contra
vocabulary.meaning: assertions I and J state the same relation with opposite asserted values and overlapping scope and conditions

vocabulary.name: reduces
vocabulary.meaning: effect E reduces its object

vocabulary.name: usecond
vocabulary.meaning: condition kind K constrains use (not a measurement condition)

vocabulary.name: isa
vocabulary.meaning: X is a subtype, instance or variant of Y (transitive)

vocabulary.name: artefact
vocabulary.meaning: K is a category, subtype, product or variant

vocabulary.name: member
vocabulary.meaning: K is a single artefact (product or variant)

vocabulary.name: capall
vocabulary.meaning: assertion I documents that K (every member, or K itself) has capability F

vocabulary.name: capsome
vocabulary.meaning: only some or most members of K have F

vocabulary.name: capdenied
vocabulary.meaning: a source denies that K has F

vocabulary.name: capconflict
vocabulary.meaning: sources affirm and deny that K has F

vocabulary.name: capok
vocabulary.meaning: K has F, not denied, no essential condition violated

vocabulary.name: capdoc
vocabulary.meaning: K has F by a non-hypothetical assertion

vocabulary.name: caphyp
vocabulary.meaning: K has F only by hypothetical assertions

vocabulary.name: capcond
vocabulary.meaning: K has F under a condition that is unknown or modifiable in the request

vocabulary.name: presenceonly
vocabulary.meaning: K has F only through the presence of an enabling component (level never established)

vocabulary.name: ctxknown
vocabulary.meaning: the request states context R

vocabulary.name: violated
vocabulary.meaning: an essential condition of I does not hold in the request

vocabulary.name: unknowncond
vocabulary.meaning: a use condition of I is not stated in the request

vocabulary.name: modviolated
vocabulary.meaning: a modifiable condition of I does not hold

vocabulary.name: addr
vocabulary.meaning: assertion I says strategy T addresses the requested X

vocabulary.name: contraid
vocabulary.meaning: assertion I is contradicted by another

vocabulary.name: relevant
vocabulary.meaning: strategy T addresses requested X and is not contradicted or excluded

vocabulary.name: deniedreport
vocabulary.meaning: a source says T does not address requested X

vocabulary.name: conflictreport
vocabulary.meaning: contradictory sources on whether T addresses X

vocabulary.name: exstrat
vocabulary.meaning: strategy T is excluded by the request or opposes a requested need

vocabulary.name: opposes
vocabulary.meaning: T acts on the dimension of requested need N in the opposite direction

vocabulary.name: conflictout
vocabulary.meaning: a source says T conflicts with requested need N

vocabulary.name: posscause
vocabulary.meaning: C is a possible cause of requested situation X

vocabulary.name: confirmedcause
vocabulary.meaning: a user fact confirms C for X

vocabulary.name: mechrel
vocabulary.meaning: T acts to reduce a POSSIBLE cause C of X (mechanistic hypothesis)

vocabulary.name: addrhyp
vocabulary.meaning: T addresses X only by a hypothetical assertion

vocabulary.name: stratviol
vocabulary.meaning: an essential condition of T addressing the request is violated

vocabulary.name: stratcond
vocabulary.meaning: a condition of T is unknown or modifiable in the request

vocabulary.name: cand
vocabulary.meaning: K is evaluated as a realisation of strategy T

vocabulary.name: gmet
vocabulary.meaning: K meets requirement group G of T

vocabulary.name: gunmet
vocabulary.meaning: K does not meet requirement group G of T

vocabulary.name: unmet
vocabulary.meaning: some requirement group of T is unmet by K

vocabulary.name: realises
vocabulary.meaning: K meets every requirement group of T

vocabulary.name: partial
vocabulary.meaning: K meets some but not all requirement groups of T (necessary, not sufficient)

vocabulary.name: somemembers
vocabulary.meaning: only some members of K have the missing capability F

vocabulary.name: levelunv
vocabulary.meaning: K realises T but a required level is not evidenced

vocabulary.name: applies
vocabulary.meaning: X holds in the request

vocabulary.name: contraart
vocabulary.meaning: contraindication I of K with force F applies

vocabulary.name: unsuitable
vocabulary.meaning: an essential contraindication of K applies

vocabulary.name: condposs
vocabulary.meaning: a modifiable or unknown-force contraindication of K applies

vocabulary.name: disadvantage
vocabulary.meaning: a nonessential contraindication of K applies

vocabulary.name: solution
vocabulary.meaning: K realises relevant purchase strategy T and is not unsuitable or excluded

vocabulary.name: conditional
vocabulary.meaning: the solution holds only under a condition, an unverified level or a modifiable contraindication

vocabulary.name: candidate
vocabulary.meaning: an unconditional candidate

vocabulary.name: notsuitable
vocabulary.meaning: K would realise relevant T but is unsuitable

vocabulary.name: partialonly
vocabulary.meaning: K provides necessary capabilities of relevant T but not all (never a solution)

vocabulary.name: nopurchase
vocabulary.meaning: a relevant strategy that needs no purchase

vocabulary.name: hypsolution
vocabulary.meaning: the solution rests on a hypothetical assertion

vocabulary.name: consult
vocabulary.meaning: K provides a necessary capability of T, which addresses N (consultation only)

vocabulary.name: serves
vocabulary.meaning: K realises T, which addresses N (validated)

vocabulary.name: deniedfor
vocabulary.meaning: a source says a strategy realised with K does not address N

vocabulary.name: contractx
vocabulary.meaning: K is contraindicated for X

vocabulary.name: assessesneed
vocabulary.meaning: property P assesses X

vocabulary.name: demo
vocabulary.meaning: a measured result about K itself, under conditions comparable to the request, bears on X

vocabulary.name: obsincomp
vocabulary.meaning: a measurement condition of O does not hold in the request

vocabulary.name: obsunk
vocabulary.meaning: a measurement condition of O is not stated in the request

vocabulary.name: related
vocabulary.meaning: K and Y are in the same artefact hierarchy

vocabulary.name: measuredelsewhere
vocabulary.meaning: a measured result about another artefact of the hierarchy bears on X (not transferred)

vocabulary.name: measuredincomp
vocabulary.meaning: a measured result about K bears on X but under non-comparable conditions

rules.statement: what every member of K has, each member has (downward only)
a component every member has enables F

rules.rule: capall(K,F,I) :- asr(_,K,has_component,C,affirmed,M,_), member(K), M != possible, asr(I,C,enables,F,affirmed,_,_).
rules.statement: a component the artefact has enables F
presence of a component, level never established (F10)

rules.rule: capsome(K,F) :- asr(_,K,has_capability,F,affirmed,M,_), M != necessary, not member(K).
rules.statement: some or most members have F (never inherited, F12)
a denial for the family holds for its members
affirmed and denied (F7: reported, no conclusion)
essential applicability condition does not hold
a use condition is not stated in the request

rules.rule: capok(K,F) :- capall(K,F,I), not capdenied(K,F), not violated(I).
rules.statement: K has F in this request

rules.rule: capdoc(K,F) :- capall(K,F,I), not hyp(I), not violated(I).
relevant(T,X) :- addr(T,X,I), not contraid(I), not exstrat(T).
mechrel(T,X,C) :- posscause(X,C), et(T,strategy), asr(_,T,acts_on,C,affirmed,_,E), reduces(E), not exstrat(T).
rules.statement: mechanistic hypothesis on a possible cause (I2)
essential condition of the strategy violated

rules.rule: cand(T,K) :- relevant(T,_), skind(T,acquire_artefact), req(T,F,_), capok(K,F), artefact(K).
rules.statement: evaluate artefacts with at least one required capability
only some members have the missing capability (F12)

rules.rule: solution(T,K) :- realises(T,K), relevant(T,_), skind(T,acquire_artefact), not unsuitable(K), not excluded(K), not stratviol(T).

rules.statement: necessary not sufficient: never a solution

rules.rule: nopurchase(T) :- relevant(T,_), skind(T,S), S != acquire_artefact, not stratviol(T).
consult(K,N,T) :- qartefact(K), artefact(K), req(T,F,_), capok(K,F), asr(_,T,addresses,N,affirmed,_,_).

rules.statement: category-first validated only when the forward realisation holds (C2)

rules.rule: demo(K,X) :- qartefact(K), obs(O,K,P,_), obsmeasured(O), assessesneed(P,X), not obsincomp(O), not obsunk(O).
rules.statement: demonstrated for this artefact and conditions only

rules.rule: measuredelsewhere(K,X) :- qartefact(K), related(K,Y), K != Y, obs(O,Y,P,_), obsmeasured(O), assessesneed(P,X).
measuredincomp(K,X) :- qartefact(K), obs(O,K,P,_), obsmeasured(O), assessesneed(P,X), obsincomp(O).
